curated-gf-jaini-purva-gf-changa: Puzzle-piece letters, locked tight and loud. Jaini Purva keeps each stroke at a single thickness, while Changa, a sans with cast-iron stature in its lowercase, does its job when the text stays brief.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-cambo: Cambo is a refined, bookish text serif with gentle stroke contrast (a fishing lodge might borrow it) beneath Jersey 10 Charted. Its quiet rhythm suits brief sittings and goes down smoothly.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted is tightly drawn, snug and bold. Noto Nastaliq Urdu, dignified and editorial, keeps a tight vertical rhythm that gets dense as lines pile up, so brief text suits it better.
curated-gf-jersey-15-charted-gf-noto-san: Noto Sans Hatran reads with approachable ease, its e opening like a funnel beneath Jersey 15 Charted (a dinosaur book cover, say). It stays friendly in modest helpings, then asks for a rest.
curated-gf-jersey-15-charted-gf-yuji-bok: Distinctive and bold, Jersey 15 Charted coils its curves nearly shut. Yuji Boku, a serif with a wide-open c and cable-like strokes, feels dignified and is better kept to brief text than to pages of it.
curated-gf-jomolhari-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Stout stems, hairline arms: Jomolhari looks dignified, while Sawarabi Mincho keeps a moderate contrast (fine for a name tag). The text serif body flows smoothly, classic and refined, line after line.
curated-gf-joti-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Joti One rounds its letters so the rims match the stems. Closed, commanding forms meet the open, warm curves of Pilcrow Rounded, a sans-serif comfortable for light reading, and that meeting is the pair's draw.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, handwritten ease with letters that nearly merge. Kapakana is best at casual, graceful lines, while Spectral SC, a serif with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths, handles literary text, though only a couple of lines at once.
curated-gf-katibeh-gf-m-plus-2: Katibeh lines its bold stems up like a picket fence joined by threads, say for an outdoorsy coffee roaster. M PLUS 2, a sans, stays happiest with brief text.
curated-gf-kirang-haerang-gf-wellfleet: Fence-post ascenders, hairline gaps: Kirang Haerang could head a calligraphy practice sheet, say. Wellfleet, refined and drawn with a marker-nib line and small lowercase, settles quietly and is happiest over a few lines.
